+const joi = require('joi');
+async function testPluginOptionsSchema(fn, opts) {
+  const s = fn({ Joi: joi });
+  const partial = joi.object(Object.keys(opts).reduce((a,k)=>{a[k]=s.extract(k);return a;},{}));
+  try { await partial.validateAsync(opts,{abortEarly:false}); }
+  catch(e){
+    const m=new Map();
+    for(const d of e.details){const [key,index]=d.path;
+      if(typeof index==='number'){const msg=d.message.replace(`"${key}[${index}]"`,`"[${index}]"`);
+        m.set(key, m.has(key)?`${m.get(key)}. ${msg}`:`"${key}" ${msg}`);}
+      else m.set(key,d.message);}
+    return {isValid:false, errors:[...m.values()]};
+  }
+  return {isValid:true, errors:[]};
+}
